title: 第17章 升官
content_zh:
次日一大早，田牧川等人就回来了。

    “田大人，情况怎么样？”魏乐府察觉到了田牧川脸色上的神色并不好看。

    “被压下来了。”田牧川语气不爽地说道：“咱们的功劳虽然拿回来了，但是...”

    “沈千钧被州府里硬保下来了。”

    “那位夏银衣来历不一般，关系太硬了，也不知道是什么来历，连县令找的人都没辙。”

    这话让魏乐府敏锐地察觉到了不对，这解决得太快了。

    以他的估算，哪怕保下人，至少也得三五个月甚至更久，期间他也得跟着配合。

    可这一次的结果却是草草了事，甚至流程都没走完。

    除了有更高级的人降维打击，也有可能是出了某些大事。

    “田大人，难不成有什么大事？”魏乐府试探性地问道。

    田牧川听到这话，叹了一口气说道：“北方，造反了。”

    魏乐府脸上震惊，但实际上觉得理所当然。

    就他们六扇门这么黑这么贪，其他官吏估计也差不了多少，官逼民反也不奇怪。

    “可是，北方离咱们这也不近呀，怎么还能影响到咱们这里。”魏乐府不解地问道。

    离得虽然不至于十万八千里那么远，但也不至于有影响。

    “北方那边的叛军确实影响不到咱们这边，但他们的影响力可以。”田牧川无奈地说道。

    “自从北方造反开始，消息到哪里，哪里就有人响应举旗。”

    “也就是消息还没有到咱们这里，不然咱们这里也不安宁。”

    “而且就算是咱们本地稳住了，可也有可能会被周边出现的叛军盯上。”

    “上头没有那么多心思放在内斗上，这才各打五十大板就了事了。”

    魏乐府沉默了，这真就计划赶不上变化。

    “这...怎么之前一点前兆都没有？”魏乐府也是装傻问道。

    实际上，只要走访过都能知道已经是沸反盈天了。

    “听说，是北方那边出了个能人。”田牧川说道：“短短三天就凝成了一股大势。”

    “近些时日更是势如破竹。”

    “朝廷都还没有来得及派人去镇压，就已经占据一州之地了。”
content_en:
Early the next morning, Tian Muchuan and others came back.

"Master Tian, ​​how is the situation?" Wei Yuefu noticed that the look on Tian Muchuan's face was not good-looking.

"We were suppressed." Tian Muchuan said in a displeased tone: "Although we have got our credit back, but..."

"Shen Qianjun was forced to stay by the state government."

"That Xia Yinyi has an unusual background. His connections are too strong. I don't know where he came from. He can't even find someone who the county magistrate is looking for."

These words made Wei Yuefu keenly aware that something was wrong, and it was solved too quickly.

According to his estimate, even if the person is guaranteed, it will take at least three to five months or even longer, and he will have to cooperate during this period.

But this time the result was hasty and the process was not even completed.

In addition to more advanced people reducing the dimensionality and attacking, it is also possible that something big has happened.

"Master Tian, ​​is there something important?" Wei Yuefu asked tentatively.

When Tian Muchuan heard this, he sighed and said, "The North has rebelled."

Wei Yuefu looked shocked, but actually he felt it was natural.

As the Six Gates are so shady and corrupt, other officials are probably not much different, so it's not surprising that the government forces the people to rebel.

"But the north is not close to us, so how can it still affect us?" Wei Yuefu asked puzzledly.

Although it's not that far away, it won't have any impact.

"It is true that the rebels in the north cannot affect our side, but their influence can." Tian Muchuan said helplessly.

"Since the rebellion started in the north, wherever the news goes, people will respond and raise the flag."

"That is to say, the news has not reached us yet, otherwise our place would not be peaceful."

"And even if our local area is stabilized, we may still be targeted by rebels appearing in the surrounding area."

"The higher-ups don't have that much focus on internal fighting, so they just give each other fifty and that's it."

Wei Yuefu was silent. This plan really couldn't keep up with the changes.

"This...why was there no warning before?" Wei Yuefu also pretended to be stupid and asked.

In fact, anyone who has visited can tell that it is already in a state of flux.

"I heard that a capable person came out from the north." Tian Muchuan said, "In just three days, a general trend has been formed."

"In recent days, it has become even more overwhelming."

"The imperial court had not even had time to send people to suppress it, but it had already occupied a state."
